newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia MinFin repays 2.29 trln rbls of bonds early.
newsitem.headline: Russia MinFin repays 2.29 trln rbls of bonds early.

text.p: Russia's Finance Ministry repaid 1.29 trillion roubles nominal value OFZ interest-bearing bond (series 24005) and one trillion roubles nominal of OFZ bond (series 24007) before maturity, a central bank official said on Thursday.

Securities Department Head Alexei Drugov told Reuters the Finance Ministry repaid the bonds held in the central bank's portfolio with the proceeds from GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ bonds sales on the secondary market.
Dealers said the move would not affect the market since the paper held by the central bank had probably never traded.
Currently there are 4.59 trillion roubles worth of series 24005 bonds and 4.61 trillion roubles worth of series 24007 bonds on the secondary market.
Series 24005 bonds mature on July 9, 1997 and series 24007 mature on March 11, 1998.
